description: manni docs key/ci, run in a repo whose manni.config.yaml holds a key, with an encrypted /owner on docs/auth.md, an encrypted citation source on docs/limits.md, and a citation baseline. One run walks the runbook, a narrowed rotation, a resumed rotation, and the refusals.

steps.description: Step 1: meta validate is green under the current key.

runShell.stdio: 2 files checked, 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors

steps.description: Step 1: cite check is green under the current key.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:\d+ current\s+~\S+:2 current[\s\S]*2 files checked, 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: Step 2: the dry run re-encrypts both values in memory and writes nothing.

runShell.stdio: /docs\/auth\.md: \/owner[\s\S]*docs\/limits\.md: fetch-timeout[\s\S]*2 values re-encrypted in 2 files, 0 skipped\s+Dry run: nothing written\./

steps.description: Step 2: nothing was written, so the gate still reads the same.

runShell.stdio: 2 files checked, 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors

steps.description: Step 3: rotate the whole family; the new key is written to the config and the baseline is flagged.

runShell.stdio: /2 values re-encrypted in 2 files, 0 skipped\s+Encryption key written to manni\.config\.yaml\.\s+The citation baseline fingerprints id-less encrypted citations by their pin/

steps.description: Step 5: re-record the citation baseline.

runShell.stdio: /2 files checked, 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings\s+Baseline written to \.manni-cite-baseline\.json/

steps.description: Step 6: meta validate reads as it did in step 1.

runShell.stdio: 2 files checked, 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors

steps.description: Step 6: cite check reads as it did in step 1.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:\d+ current\s+~\S+:2 current[\s\S]*2 files checked, 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

tests.description: Rotate one area at a time.

steps.description: A narrowed run needs --to.

runShell.stdio: A run over part of the family needs --to, and never writes the key.

steps.description: The narrowed run with --to re-encrypts auth.md and does not write the key.

runShell.stdio: /1 value re-encrypted in 1 file, 0 skipped\s+Key not written: this run covered part of the family\./

steps.description: Between the two runs the gate is red.

runShell.stdio: /docs\/auth\.md\s+\/owner  \/owner does not decrypt under the current key[\s\S]*\[encrypted:unreadable\][\s\S]*2 files checked, 1 passed, 1 failed, 1 error/

steps.description: The whole run under the same value re-encrypts only limits.md and writes the key.

runShell.stdio: /docs\/limits\.md: fetch-timeout[\s\S]*1 value re-encrypted in 1 file, 0 skipped\s+Encryption key written to manni\.config\.yaml\./

steps.description: Green again.

runShell.stdio: 2 files checked, 2 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors

tests.description: Resume an interrupted rotation. A run stopped between its first and last write leaves limits.md under the new key, auth.md under the old one, and both keys in the config.

steps.description: Re-encrypt limits.md alone under the new key.

runShell.stdio: Key not written

steps.description: Write the config a stopped run leaves: the new key, with the old one beside it.
The page the run did not reach reports encrypted:unreadable.

runShell.stdio: /docs\/auth\.md\s+\/owner  \/owner does not decrypt under the current key[\s\S]*\[encrypted:unreadable\][\s\S]*2 files checked, 1 passed, 1 failed, 1 error/

steps.description: key set is refused until the rotation finishes.

runShell.stdio: A rotation is unfinished in manni.config.yaml. Run `manni key rotate` with no --to to finish it.

steps.description: rotate --to is refused until the rotation finishes.

runShell.stdio: A rotation is unfinished in manni.config.yaml. Run `manni key rotate` with no --to to finish it.

steps.description: rotate with no --to finishes the job and says so above the counts.

runShell.stdio: /Finished the interrupted rotation in manni\.config\.yaml\.\s+1 value re-encrypted in 1 file, 0 skipped/

steps.description: encryptionKeyPrevious is removed.
Green under the finished key.

steps.description: A --to shorter than 32 characters.

runShell.stdio: --to must be at least 32 hex or base64url characters.

steps.description: rotate takes no stdin.

runShell.stdio: key rotate reads and writes files, so it takes no stdin (`-`). Name the files instead.
